generate_inference_dialogue_pairs: generate dialogue input output pairs for inference using DialoguePredictionFormatter with game JSON and format parts
generate_training_dialogue_pairs: generate training dialogue input output pairs using TrainingDialoguePredictionFormatter with message filtering and editing
format_dialogue_sequence_parts: parse a format string into DialogueSequencePart enums using get_format_parts to specify state orders and history
filter_and_edit_messages: build message marker filterer and editor to mark filter or edit bad messages like offensive language or redacted text
generate_discriminator_examples: generate human versus model discriminator training examples by blending real and model generated messages
